text:
A copper wire is placed in an electrical circuit and its resistance is measured. The wire is then
replaced with a second copper wire with twice the length and a quarter of the diameter.
What is the ratio of the resistance for the two wires?
A
1:2
B
1:4
C
1:8
D
1:32
subject: Physics
